description: This PHP source file defines the EmpContractDecorator class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to access and manipulate employee contract data, including start/end dates, attachments, and employee associations.

classes.name: EmpContractDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmpContract entity providing additional functionality such as date formatting, attachment retrieval, and employee association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpContract instance.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmploymentContractService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the contract start date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the contract end date formatted as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Fetches the contract attachment for the employee associated with this contract.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the contract based on the employee number.
